1. The NiTi wire was subjected to an aging process at 600 °C for 1 h under vacuum in a Lindberg Blue 1′′ Quartz CVD tube furnace.
2. The vanadium oxide coatings were deposited on the aged NiTi wires using a GemStar 6″ ALD system at a reaction temperature of 200 °C.
3. The deposited oxide films were annealed at 450 °C for 30 min in a Lindberg Blue 1″ Quartz CVD tube furnace open to air to achieve crystalline coatings of vanadium pentoxide (V2O5) on the surface of the alloy.

Note that the NiTi wire was also mechanically polished and sonicated, but these were not heat treatments.
